description: This file contains functions related to the upgrade process for I-O DATA MSTC devices based on MitraStar Technology Corp. It includes functions to prepare the environment, check and set boot flags, and handle failures during the upgrade process.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure during the upgrade preparation, outputs an error message, unmounts all filesystems, and reboots the device.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by checking and setting boot and debug flags on specific memory partitions, with error handling and fallback.
